product_guide.title: SOL Everyday Bottle — Product Guide
pages:
SOL Everyday Bottle — Product Guide
SOL is a two-person studio in Seoul making plain, well-built things for daily life. The Everyday
Bottle is our first product.
Temperature
The double-wall vacuum body keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours and hot for up to 12 hours. We
measured this at a room temperature of 22°C with the lid closed and the bottle filled to the top.
Results will be shorter if the bottle is opened often or left in direct sun.
Materials
The body is made of 18/8 stainless steel. The lid is made of BPA-free polypropylene with a silicone
seal. There is no plastic in contact with the drink except the inside of the lid.
Size
The bottle holds 500 ml and weighs 310 g empty. It fits most car cup holders and the side pocket
of a standard backpack.

Care
Hand wash the body with warm water and mild soap. The lid is top-rack dishwasher safe. Do not
put the body in the dishwasher, freezer or microwave, because heat and cold can damage the
vacuum seal.
What testers said
We gave 40 bottles to office workers in Seoul for two weeks before launch. One tester wrote: "I
finally drink water at my desk because it is still cold at 4 pm."
Price and warranty
The Everyday Bottle costs 32,000 won and comes in sage, sand and charcoal. Every bottle has a
two-year warranty against defects in the vacuum seal.
Where to buy
Order online at sol-studio.example or visit our pop-up at Seongsu-dong on weekends in
November.

Keep the the post friendly and remind people the lid can go in the dishwasher but the bottle should be hand washed by hand.
